source_preview:
MongoDB DBA_JD

Job Title :- MongoDB Database Administrator
Experience :- 1 to 4 years
Location :- Mumbai, Navi Mumbai (On-site)

Required Skills:-

•
Mandatory to have skills of Managing MongoDB databases through MongoDB Atlas.

•
Mandatory to have worked on Clustering.

•
Perform routine maintenance tasks, including backups, indexing, and optimization.

•
Monitor database performance and ensure high availability and reliability.

•
Implement clustering and sharding strategies for scaling databases.

•
Troubleshoot and resolve database issues.

•
Assist in database design, including schema design and indexing strategies.

•
Ensure data security and implement data recovery plans.

•
Collaborate with development teams to optimize queries and improve performance.

•
Document database environments and processes.

•
Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems.

•
Experience with other NoSQL databases.

•
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
